what_neither_side_counts: the witness extraction. The proved side's `loop_secs` reads a witness that a prior extraction step produced; that step is in no boundary and has no unproved counterpart.
model / weight load, and on the proved side the kernel-store emit and the prover binary's own start-up.
verification. Every number here is prover-side.

the inference pass itself, on the PROVED side: none of the four boundaries contains one. So an overhead multiple U/P is prover-seconds over inference-seconds -- precisely what fn. 170 computed (zkLLM's 803 s over 668 tok/s). A deployment that must infer AND prove costs (1 + U/P) x the unproved time; at x25-40 that unit is immaterial, and it is stated anyway.
e11_assumption: REGIME 1, the same convention stream E7 used in notes/sufficiency.md: every proved position is charged one measured C=4096 decoded token, so the proved rate in positions/second equals the frozen tok/s row unchanged. This is CONSERVATIVE for E11 -- a prompt position inside a causal rectangle attends to ~N/2 keys, not a full C band -- and it is an assumption, not a measurement: no E11 proved row exists. The unproved side needs no assumption; it is measured directly as (prompt + output) / wall of the concatenated pass.

boundary_definitions.commit: the commitment path only: interpolate + LDE extend + Merkle over the committed trees. Our best boundary; already at the card's hashing rate.
boundary_definitions.stwo total: commit + `prove_ex` (constraint eval, quotients, OODS, FRI). The stwo prover's own call.
boundary_definitions.whole wall: trace generation + interaction generation + stwo total + serialization, summed per chunk. NOTE: `whole_wall` has NEVER counted the witness read or the layer build (stream O finding) -- under the pipelined loop that term is most of the wall.
boundary_definitions.loop_secs: the one-process chunk loop's own wall (`compose-chunks`), which DOES include the witness read and layer build. Serial or pipelined (`B7_M5_PIPE=1`, one chunk ahead). A FOURTH boundary, not comparable to `whole wall`; named because W/X/Z/O numbers live there.
boundary_definitions.unknown: another group's number whose boundary they did not state. Say so in the paper.
boundary_definitions.n/a: not a proving measurement (hardware, survey, cost, quality).
boundary_definitions.unproved decode wall: the unproved side's own boundary: forward passes with weights resident, warmup and prompt tokenization outside the timed region. See a run artifact's `boundary` block.
